cooldown.binNote: Bin YuumiP#PassiveCooldown continues decreasing by 1 per level all the way to level 18 (value 3), whereas the wiki states the cooldown falls from 20 to 8 over levels 1-13 and then plateaus at 8 for levels 14-18.

values.meaning: heal to Yuumi (and shared ally heal) on empowered attack/ability consume
values.binNote: Wiki values are the bin's YuumiP#HealAmount flat values rounded to two decimals (e.g. 25.2941176 -> 25.29); no discrepancy in the underlying formula, just display rounding.

mechanics.claim: The empowered-attack buff is consumed on hitting a basic attack, Prowling Projectile, or a Final Chapter hit on allies while attached, to heal Yuumi; if she is or becomes attached to an ally within 4 seconds, they are healed for the same amount.
mechanics.quote: the buff is consumed to {{tip|heal}} her for {{pp|20 + (110-20)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}. If she is ''{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|attached}}'' to an ally or does so within 4 seconds, they are healed for the same amount.

mechanics.claim: The heal proc will not be consumed if Yuumi is not missing health, except when triggered by a basic attack.
mechanics.quote: ''Feline Friendship'' will not be consumed if '''Yuumi''' isn't missing health, except when triggered by a basic attack.
